thread:
olivia: FYI LegalBank again. They've moved from exploratory to ready-to-sign but want a concrete capacity + compliance plan before legal signs. Key asks: steady 2M tokens/mo, short spikes up to ~10k RPS, strict p95 200ms, p99 < 600ms, customer-managed KMS/HSM, and 7y audit retention. Need presales runbook + cost impact and a short ops playbook. Can we outline? cc @maria @ajay @taylor @jenna @sam

maria: Thanks. Two quick clarifying Qs: 1) are spikes predictable windows or fully random? 2) do they require zero-e2e-data-egress (private only)?

olivia: Spikes: mostly deterministic windows (08:30-09:15 and 17:45-18:30 local). They want private deployment for the highest-tier contract but open to hybrid for initial POC.

ajay: Ok. High-level recommendation: reserved pool sized for base load + quantized models (gptq/int8) to hit cost targets, plus a separate pre-warmed burst pool for the predictable windows. Autoscale policy should prefer local AZ capacity then spill to cross-AZ warm nodes (avoid cold cold starts).

taylor: Ops nuance: if burst uses spot instances we must define eviction fallback -> immediate routing to quantized variant in other AZs. Also preheat plan: run KV-cache loader 15m before window, load top-50 prefixes and recent session KV snapshots.

sam: For KMS/HSM: LegalBank insists on customer-managed keys and HSM attestation. We can offer a Private deployment with KMS integration and audit log export to their S3. Need security sign-off for 7-year retention (long). @jenna can confirm feasibility.

jenna: We can support HSM-backed KMIP or cloud-KMS with BYOK, and stream audit logs to customer-controlled bucket. Retention 7y OK but will add storage cost; need to lock in retention in contract. I'll draft questionnaire responses.

maria: Work items: 1) @ajay produce cost comparison int8 vs fp16 + token cost projection for steady and burst (include GPU hrs & prewarm charges). 2) @taylor produce preheat + KV warmup runbook and AZ-failover steps. 3) @jenna draft KMS/HSM + audit retention answers. 4) @sam outline Private deployment network diagram and egress constraints.

ajay: Quick sketch of autoscale policy (draft):
```json
{
  "policy":"predictable-burst",
  "steady_pool":{ "gpus":3, "model":"gptq-8k-int8", "target_p95_ms":180 },
  "burst_pool":{ "gpus":6, "model":"fp16-8k", "prewarm_minutes":20 },
  "fallback":"cross_az_quantized",
  "scale_triggers":{ "queue_ms":150, "spike_window_s":90 }
}
```

taylor: Nice. Add: prewarm script should verify KV load + run synthetic qps ramp for 5m at 60% expected spike QPS. Include health checks and canary traffic shift (10% -> 50% -> 100%).

ajay: Cost delta estimate (very rough): quantized steady path ~35% lower GPU compute; pre-warm burst adds ~6-10% to steady monthly cost depending on prewarm duration and reserved credits. I'll calculate with actual A100/4090 SKU numbers tomorrow.

olivia: Good. Also need an explicit SLA paragraph for AZ failover: cross-AZ reserve + canary + fallback to quantized variant to avoid user-visible errors; increase p99 during failover expected but aim to keep p95 within SLO.

maria: I'll assemble a single-page presales doc with bullet points: recommended pools, autoscale policy, preheat runbook, compliance notes, cost delta, and draft questionnaire answers. Target to send to customer 24h before Thursday sync.

deploy-bot: Provisioning update: reserve request rb-9001 created (region=us-east-1) initial nodes=3, burst_target=6. ETA ~35m.

olivia: Great. Meeting scheduled with LegalBank Thursday 10:00am ET. @ajay @taylor pls be ready to walk through perf tradeoffs and failover runbook. If security raises blockers, we'll escalate to enterprise eng. :thumbsup:
